capture_method: Manual page-fetch tool reads of named pages on 2026-11-19 (one read per URL, no scheduled or automated crawl). The tool does not return a clock time, so only the date is recorded. Raw page bytes are not stored in the repo.
scope: Roster-event (transaction and IR) checks behind the brief's open items: Colts receiver trades, Ravens QB injured-reserve moves, Malik Willis IR, and whether the official reserve list carries them. Nothing here is a starter or depth-rank claim.

rows.claim: Colts WR Josh Downs traded IND to KC, dated 11/10
rows.observed: Official NFL 2026 November Trades table: 11/10, Josh Downs, Colts to Chiefs, 'Traded'.
rows.note: Second of the two Colts receiver trades cited in the brief's Week 10 item (RE-02).

rows.claim: Colts WR Keenan Allen traded IND to SF, dated 11/10
rows.observed: Official NFL 2026 November Trades table: 11/10, Keenan Allen, Colts to 49ers, 'Traded'.
rows.note: Together with RE-01 this confirms the two receiver trades as dated league events. The brief's 'same article as its depth chart' link was not re-checked here.

rows.claim: Jacoby Brissett traded ARI to BAL, dated 11/06
rows.observed: Official NFL 2026 November Trades table: 11/06, Jacoby Brissett, Cardinals to Ravens, 'Traded'.
rows.note: The Ravens' own 11/05 article says the trade was being finalized, so the league date and the club narrative agree.

rows.claim: Ravens placed QBs Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley on injured reserve on Thursday, 11/05
rows.observed: Ravens article dated Nov 05, 2026 04:35 PM: 'officially placed quarterbacks Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley on injured reserve Thursday.' Jackson: right thumb. Huntley: toe. Both 'will miss a minimum of four games'. QB Austin Reed signed to the 53-man roster.
rows.note: Club-published. The reserve list page checked in RE-05 does not show this move.

rows.claim: Official NFL reserve list for November 2026 carries the Ravens' 11/05 IR moves
rows.observed: Both pages of the November 2026 reserve list were read. Entries run from 11/18 down to 11/10 (Jordan Whittington, LA). No Baltimore row appears. No row is dated 11/05 to 11/09.
rows.note: The official log is missing the Jackson and Huntley IR moves in RE-04. Flagged; the club article is kept as the source for the move and the league log is not used to contradict it.

rows.claim: Dolphins placed QB Malik Willis on injured reserve, dated 11/10
rows.observed: NBC Sports (Pro Football Talk), dated Nov 10, 2026: 'The Dolphins placed quarterback Malik Willis on injured reserve, the team announced.' NFLTradeRumors (https://nfltraderumors.co/dolphins-placing-qb-malik-willis-on-ir) reports the same. The official NFL reserve list for November 2026 (https://www.nfl.com/transactions/league/reserve-list/2026/11) has no Willis row.
rows.note: No official Dolphins or NFL page confirming the move was found in this check. The Dolphins news page fetched on 2026-11-19 shows the later IR moves for Zeek Biggers and Jordan Phillips (RE-07) but not Willis in its first chunk. Marked unverified, not confirmed.

rows.claim: Dolphins placed DL Zeek Biggers and DL Jordan Phillips on injured reserve, dated 11/17
rows.observed: Dolphins news item: the team 'announced today that they have placed defensive linemen Zeek Biggers and Jordan Phillips on the injured reserve list.' The NFL reserve list (RE-05 source) shows both rows dated 11/17.
rows.note: Cross-check. The club and league sources agree for this move, which shows the league list captures some club IR moves but not the Ravens' or Willis's.
